name: Koh Phangan
blurb: Online conversation about Koh Phangan is quiet with an 18% drop in growth, centering heavily around its party scene, Full Moon parties, and electronic music events. Recent discussions also highlight government crackdowns on foreign-owned businesses and visa issues.

positive: Great destination for electronic music, raves, and Full Moon parties
Appreciated for community, writing retreats, and reasonable long-term living costs
Enjoyed for scenic sunrises, beaches, and local cafes
negative: Government crackdowns and raids targeting foreign-owned businesses and illegal hotels
Visa revocations and law enforcement scrutiny regarding long-stay foreign nationals
Concerns over unresolved local issues like dog poisonings
